name: Conus Medullaris Syndrome
definition: Neurological syndrome caused by injury or compression of the terminal spinal cord near the conus, often producing mixed upper/lower motor-neuron findings with early sphincter and saddle sensory dysfunction.

typical: Acute or subacute bilateral leg symptoms

redFlags.item: Any suspected conus syndrome is an emergency

investigations.principle: Urgent MRI of the thoracolumbar junction/lumbar spine is central when compression is suspected.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, tumor, occult injury or condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

green: Bladder and pressure-area care when required
amber: Do not delay imaging or decompression for conservative or Ayurvedic treatment.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Any Vata-neurological framework is secondary to emergency modern diagnosis and decompression pathway.

patientEducation.summary: Neurological syndrome caused by injury or compression of the terminal spinal cord near the conus, often producing mixed upper/lower motor-neuron findings with early sphincter and saddle sensory dysfunction.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
